title: Reserve Our Time Cottage Rosemary Beach Florida Rental | Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: A private beach and private pool await you in this luxury cottage. Enjoy 5 spacious bedrooms, large kitchen, and outdoor grill. Just a few steps away from the beach. Book now!
description_expanded:
Property includes private beach access at The Bluffs with 2 sets of beach chairs and the Beach Better Box included (March 1 - October 31) . Additional beach service chairs can be rented through Jake's Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

This luxury rental is located in a private community of 10 homes that share a gulf front pool and private beach of their own. It is located just outside the Rosemary Beach community. No access to Rosemary Beach community pools or beach walkovers.

Inlet Beach Luxury

Only minutes from Rosemary Beach, Our Time Cottage is a beautiful Gulf-front property in Inlet Beach.

Our Time is a 4-story cottage with an elevator that descends down to the outdoor living and summer kitchen at the beach level. Step away from the outdoor living and kitchen to the community's private gated staircase leading down to the beach and Gulf below. Enjoy the Gulf-front community pool and head back to Our Time where Gulf views are just the beginning. The spectacular views from the second floor living room, third floor master suite and fourth floor bonus room offer a wonderful place to relax and watch the sunset.

Immediately off the living room is one of three wide balconies, wet bar and private sandy sunning area.

Each of the five bedrooms has a private bath. Our Time's bedrooms feature 4 king beds and 2 bunks (4 extra-long twins).

The cottage also features a multimedia room, a state of the art kitchen including Wolf range and Subzero fridge, flat screen televisions and centralized stereo system.

KEY FEATURES:

350 ft of private beach for The Bluffs of Inlet Beach

Gulf Front!

2 sets of beach chairs (March 1 - October 31)

Beach Better Box (March 1 - October 31)

Exclusive access to the Rosemary Beach Fitness Center and Racquet Club

Access to community pool (Heated Thanksgiving, Christmas, New Years, and March 1 - Easter)

Please note: This community prohibits beach tents, canopies, sunshades, or wind assisted shades that may look like a tent. A beach umbrella is permitted.

**THIS PROPERTY REQUIRES A 7 NIGHT RENTAL SATURDAY - SATURDAY DURING SPRING BREAK AND SUMMER**

No access to Rosemary pools or beaches
